name: gradia
description: Gradia: Sistema Web de Gestion Academica y Registro de Calificaciones

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.lint: npm --workspace backend run lint && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace backend run test:unit && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
